expectations.evidence: The 'Change for tomorrow' section gives specific changes, and each one answers a Day 1 problem. Empty notes: 'Ask one qualifying question at every scan... Write the answer in the notes field right then' and 'Grade at the booth... This takes 5 seconds.' Too many unqualified scans (220, a vanity metric): 'Stop scanning everyone... Scan only people you had a real conversation with. Fewer scans mean cleaner data.' The response also makes the link itself: 'Hold a 10-minute huddle at lunch and again at close...
